requirement: Add ability to create new header files for better code organization and modularity

extracted_facts.statement: System should allow developers to create new header files

Modular design requires flexible header file structure
Developers need ability to organize code into new headers

requirement_fact.statement: System should allow developers to create new header files

existing_fact.statement: DO NOT create new header files, use existing well-established header file structure

conflicts.reasoning: Direct contradiction: Requirement wants to create new headers, but existing constraint explicitly forbids it

requirement_fact.statement: Code organization would benefit from additional header files

existing_fact.statement: ALL new struct definitions MUST be placed in types.h

conflicts.reasoning: New headers would conflict with established pattern of centralizing structs in types.h

requirement_fact.statement: Developers need ability to organize code into new headers

existing_fact.statement: ALL new function declarations MUST be placed in functions.h

conflicts.reasoning: New headers would conflict with established pattern of centralizing functions in functions.h
